title: alirezadir Machine Learning Interviews: ML system design framework and sample questions
why: A nine step ML system design framework, metric and model lists, and the sample question list (recommendation, search, ads, fraud, ETA, moderation, LLM support chatbot).

title: Chip Huyen: Machine Learning Interviews book
why: States that almost every company asks at least one ML system design question and that candidates often find it hardest; its table of contents links the system design material.

title: Google: Rules of Machine Learning
why: Numbered practical rules on launching without ML, metrics, skew (rule 37), logging features at serving (rule 29), feedback loops and position features.

title: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems (Sculley et al., NIPS 2015)
why: CACE, correction cascades, undeclared consumers, data dependencies, feedback loops, glue code, configuration debt, monitoring starting points.

title: Deep Neural Networks for YouTube Recommendations (Covington, Adams, Sargin, RecSys 2016)
why: Two stage recommender, extreme multiclass candidate generation, example age, watch time weighted logistic regression, feature handling.

title: Practical Lessons from Predicting Clicks on Ads at Facebook (He et al., ADKDD 2014)
why: Tree plus logistic regression hybrid, normalized entropy and calibration, data freshness, online learning, negative downsampling and recalibration.

title: Meet Michelangelo: Uber's Machine Learning Platform
why: Feature store with offline and online split, shared feature definitions for training and serving, model repository and versioning, deployment modes, monitoring.
